description: This file contains unit tests for the Calculator engine, specifically testing the grouping of digits, validation of number formats across different radices, and the parsing of digit grouping strings. It uses the Microsoft C++ Unit Test Framework and references the Calculator application's view model and calculation manager components.

classes.name: CalcEngineTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the calculator engine, including number validation, digit grouping, and parsing logic.

methods.name: CommonSetup
methods.description: Initializes resources and the calculator engine before each test.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test.

methods.name: TestGroupDigitsPerRadix
methods.description: Tests the grouping of digits based on different radices and formats.

methods.name: TestIsNumberInvalid
methods.description: Validates the number format validation logic across binary, octal, hexadecimal, and decimal formats.

methods.name: TestDigitGroupingStringToGroupingVector
methods.description: Tests parsing of digit grouping strings into vectors.

methods.name: TestGroupDigits
methods.description: Tests the digit grouping function with various delimiters, groupings, and edge cases.
